chunks: Indeed, the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) shared with the Quraysh in building the House (Kaaba), and there came to be for the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), from the door of the Kaaba to the midpoint between the Yamani corner and the Black Stone.
And in another report: it was for the Banu Hashim, from the Black Stone to the Syrian corner.

key_terms.الحجر الأسود: The Black Stone — the sacred stone embedded in the eastern corner of the Kaaba
key_terms.الركن الشامي: The Syrian corner — the northern corner of the Kaaba facing Syria
key_terms.الركن اليماني: The Yamani corner — the southern corner of the Kaaba, facing Yemen
key_terms.ساهم: Participated as a stakeholder/partner in a shared endeavour

ai.seo_question: What section of the Kaaba was assigned to the Prophet Muhammad during its rebuilding by the Quraysh?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates a historical account of how the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) participated alongside the Quraysh in rebuilding the Kaaba before his prophethood, with his designated section extending from the door to the midpoint between the Yamani corner and the Black Stone. The hadith also preserves an alternative tradition attributing that section to the Banu Hashim, the Prophet's own tribe. This narration reflects the significant honour the Prophet and his clan held in the sacred precincts of Mecca even before his prophetic mission.
